test_title: PYST 42: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?

121 117.9 114.8 111.7 108.6 ?
solution:
• 
 
121 → 117.9 (−3.1)

 
 
• 
 
117.9 → 114.8 (−3.1)

 
 
• 
 
114.8 → 111.7 (−3.1)

 
 
• 
 
111.7 → 108.6 (−3.1)

 

The pattern is **subtract 3.1 each time**.

So the next term is:

**108.6 − 3.1 = 105.5**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
